units.source_text: 夕雾大将回忆那个梦，想道：“这支笛真难于处置了！

en.t: General Yugiri recalled that dream and thought, "This flute is truly difficult to deal with!

units.source_text: 这是柏木生前心爱之物，我不是应该接受的人，

en.t: It was something Kashiwagi had treasured in life, and I am not the person who ought to receive it,

units.source_text: 老夫人却把它送给我，真没有意思啊！

en.t: yet the old lady gave it to me. How awkward and pointless this is!

units.source_text: 不知柏木的亡灵对此作何感想。

en.t: I wonder what Kashiwagi's spirit thinks of this.

units.source_text: 生前并不十分关心的东西，到了临终之际，

en.t: Even something one did not care very much about while alive, when the time of death arrives,

units.source_text: 一时念及，不胜痛惜，或者伤心，恋恋不舍地死去，

en.t: may suddenly come to mind, filling one with unbearable regret or sorrow, so that one dies still clinging to it,

units.source_text: 那魂灵便永远迷惑在无明世界了。

en.t: and then that soul remains forever lost in the world of ignorance.

units.source_text: 如此看来，在这世间，对无论何物都不可执着。”

en.t: Seen in this way, in this world one must not cling to anything at all."

units.source_text: 他想了一会，就发心叫爱宕山寺僧众举办法事，

en.t: After thinking for a while, he resolved to have the monks of Atago Mountain Temple hold memorial rites,

units.source_text: 又在柏木生前所信仰的寺院中大做功德。

en.t: and he also performed many meritorious acts at the temple Kashiwagi had revered while alive.

units.source_text: 关于那支笛，他想：“老夫人为了我和柏木交情深厚，

en.t: As for the flute, he thought, "The old lady gave it to me because Kashiwagi and I were so close,
and that is why she went out of her way to send it to me.

units.source_text: 我立刻把它捐献给佛寺，倒是一件善事，

en.t: If I immediately donate it to a Buddhist temple, that would indeed be a good deed,

units.source_text: 然而未免使老夫人扫兴吧。”

en.t: but it would surely disappoint the old lady."

units.source_text: 便暂不处置，到六条院去参见父大臣了。

en.t: So he left the matter unsettled for the time being and went to Rokujo-in to pay his respects to his father, the minister.
